description: This file defines a custom exception class `ConnectTimeoutException` for signaling connection timeout errors within the `org.eclipse.hono.connection` package. It extends `RuntimeException` and provides constructors for default and message-specific instantiation.

classes.name: ConnectTimeoutException
classes.description: Custom exception class thrown when a connection attempt times out, extending RuntimeException and providing constructors for default and custom message initialization.

methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception without a specific message.
